cases.title: Logs in with valid credentials
cases.prompt: Check that a user can log in. Enter the email "demo@example.com" and the password "demo1234", submit the form, and confirm that the app reaches the logged-in shop screen listing coffee beans.

cases.title: Shows an error for a wrong password
cases.prompt: Check that logging in with a wrong password fails visibly. Enter the email "demo@example.com" and the password "wrongpass", submit the form, and confirm that the screen shows the error message "Invalid email or password". Finish with verdict "passed" once that message is visible.

cases.title: Adds a bean to the cart and sees the total
cases.prompt: Check that a customer can put a coffee bean in the cart. Log in with the email "demo@example.com" and the password "demo1234", open the "Yirgacheffe" bean from the shop list, add it to the cart, and confirm the cart screen shows a total of $18.00.

cases.title: Places an order using the confirmation code
cases.prompt: Check that a customer can complete an order. Log in with the email "demo@example.com" and the password "demo1234", add any one coffee bean to the cart, and go through checkout. The checkout screen shows a confirmation code; the screen after it asks you to type that code back in. Enter it, place the order, and confirm that an order number is shown.
